subject: mdl/sessionmanager: some refactor of MDL loop and move sessionmanager from util to session pkg (#62671)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff (first-parent) focusing on the infoschema MDL check path. `pkg/infoschema/issyncer` now represents MDL-check inputs as `mdldef.JobMDL` (job schema ver + pre-parsed tableID set) and `MDLCheckLoop` passes a single jobs map to `sessmgr.Manager.CheckOldRunningTxn`; the production implementation (`pkg/server/server.go` -> `session.RemoveLockDDLJobs`) preserves the core invariant by deleting jobs when any session has accessed an involved table with schema version < job.Ver, so `UpdateSelfVersion` only runs for jobs that can safely proceed. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata consistency/state-machine handling, compatibility, or concurrency for the touched infoschema MDL path.
